projects.title: GPS + IoT-Based Vehicle Monitoring System
projects.concept: A real-time hardware and software telemetry tracking solution for vehicle logistics.
projects.desc: Integrates an ESP32 microcontroller with GPS antenna and GSM modules to continuously monitor geographic location, route history, and payload weight changes.

projects.title: Welcome Robot Assistant
projects.concept: An interactive, edge-AI desk assistant powered by a Raspberry Pi 5.
projects.desc: Employs Vosk for offline speech recognition, Google Gemini for intelligent conversational responses, and ElevenLabs APIs for lifelike voice synthesis.

projects.title: Text Cleaning & Preprocessing Utility
projects.concept: A dedicated NLP tool that cleans and standardizes raw text.
projects.desc: Automates the ingestion of DOCX and PDF documents, performing tokenization, stopword removal, and lemmatization for normalized dataset generation.

projects.title: IBM-Styled Login & Authentication Portal
projects.concept: A modern, accessible front-end authentication experience.
projects.desc: Engineered an IBM-inspired visual layout with a strong emphasis on clean UI/UX principles, responsiveness, and web accessibility standards.

projects.title: Mushroom Classification ML Model
projects.concept: A supervised classification model to distinguish edible from poisonous mushrooms.
projects.desc: Implements the ID3 Decision Tree algorithm to evaluate biological dataset attributes with high accuracy.
